purpose: Define strict pass/fail gates for narrow high-transmission spectra before claiming acceptance.

hard_reject_rules.condition: any accepted transmission metric interpreted as physical transmittance has peak_T > 1.0
hard_reject_rules.reason: Physical transmittance cannot exceed 1. If GUI Abs(T)^2 exceeds 1, it may still be kept as diagnostic data but cannot pass acceptance.

hard_reject_rules.condition: changing simulation time, auto shutoff, dt stability factor, mesh accuracy, or monitor extraction materially changes peak position, peak height, FWHM, or background
background has repeated local peaks, ringing, or sideband oscillations not predicted by the mechanism
hard_reject_rules.reason: Clean background is part of the target, and unexplained oscillation usually indicates numerical artifact, multiple modes, or unwanted direct channel.

hard_reject_rules.condition: field spectrum peak does not align with transmission peak or field enhancement is not localized at the designed resonant region
hard_reject_rules.reason: Transmission peak and field map must support the same physical mechanism.

hard_reject_rules.condition: field map cannot be explained by the proposed mode symmetry, cavity path, defect localization, or coupling channel
hard_reject_rules.reason: Do not accept a spectrum that cannot be explained from field behavior.

required_validation_runs.pass_hint: peak_nm and FWHM remain stable; peak_T changes only within acceptable numerical tolerance
mesh refinement does not create, remove, or strongly reshape the target peak
single field monitor shows resonant field enhancement at same wavelength as transmission peak

quality_metrics_after_hard_gates.FWHM_nm_target: as small as possible after convergence

current_d4_implication.why: Peak exceeds 1 under the user's strict acceptance rule. It remains useful as a diagnostic for coupling trend but cannot be final accepted spectrum.
